headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of shutout ball, striking out 9 and walking 1. In other action, the Washington Nationals secured a 10-7 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the charge at the plate, going 3-for-5 with 2 home runs and 3 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates also pulled off a thrilling comeback, edging out the Chicago Cubs 8-7, with Ryan O'Hearn leading the Pirates' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

Several key players have been affected by injuries. Cody Bellinger, left fielder for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Additionally, Shea Langeliers of the Athletics has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 25, 2026, with a torn meniscus in his right knee. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Minnesota Twins, Texas Rangers, Houston Astros, New York Mets, Cleveland Guardians, and Philadelphia Phillies.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place ahead of the trade deadline. The St. Louis Cardinals have sent RHP Scott Blewett to the Athletics in exchange for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates have traded RHP José Urquidy to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Felix Doroteo. The Boston Red Sox have traded LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals for 3B Curtis Mead. The Philadelphia Phillies have acquired CF Kameron Misner from the Kansas City Royals for cash.
